title: Add Private upgrade health dashboards (prechecks, migrations, error rates, rollbacks)
author: Allison Grant
body: Summary: Adds a Grafana dashboard pack for Redwood Private upgrade health, focused on the new installer-driven upgrade workflow (prechecks -> backup -> control plane rollout -> data plane rollout -> migrations -> postchecks, with rollback entry points). Dashboard set covers (1) precheck failure rates + breakdown by check_id/severity, (2) DB migration durations and timeouts/lock waits, (3) API/control-plane error rates during upgrade windows, and (4) rollback frequency + outcomes. Motivation: SRE and Release Eng asked for a single place to validate upgrade readiness and spot regressions during beta rollouts; today we rely on scattered logs and ad-hoc queries. This PR makes upgrades observable with consistent panels and variables that work in Hosted VPC Private and on-prem (including air-gapped) where only Prometheus + Loki are available. What’s included: - New dashboard: "Private Upgrades / Overview" (upgrade success rate, active upgrades, error budget impact proxy, rollbacks). - New dashboard: "Private Upgrades / Prechecks" (fail rate, top failing checks, blocking vs warning, remediation link rendering). - New dashboard: "Private Upgrades / Migrations" (p50/p95 duration by migration_name, lock wait time, failed migrations, timeouts). - New dashboard: "Private Upgrades / Upgrade Window Errors" (HTTP 5xx/429, gRPC error codes if present, control-plane reachability, installer command failure count). - Optional annotation integration: upgrade window markers derived from audit/installer events when present; otherwise uses a manual label/annotation query. Metrics/log sources: - Prometheus metrics emitted by installer/controller-plane components: redwood_private_upgrade_runs_total, redwood_private_upgrade_precheck_results_total{check_id,severity,result}, redwood_private_upgrade_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage}, redwood_db_migration_duration_seconds_bucket{migration}, redwood_db_migration_failures_total{migration,reason}, redwood_private_rollback_runs_total{result}. - Loki log-derived counters for older installs missing a subset of metrics (best-effort fallback queries). Installation notes: Dashboards are templated with common labels (cluster, environment, customer, deployment_mode). On-prem guidance included: set prometheus external_labels for customer + cluster; if unavailable, dashboards still work but variables are limited. Screenshots: attached in PR (Overview + Prechecks + Migrations). Risks/rollout: purely additive dashboards/queries; no alert changes in this PR. Follow-ups: add alerts for migration timeout and elevated rollback frequency once beta thresholds stabilize; wire in audit event fields after redwood/pr-29187 lands everywhere.
commits: dashboards(private-upgrades): add overview dashboard with active upgrade + success rate panels
dashboards(private-upgrades): add prechecks dashboard with check_id breakdown + blocking vs warning split
dashboards(private-upgrades): add migrations dashboard (duration histograms, timeouts, lock wait panels)
dashboards(private-upgrades): add upgrade-window error rate dashboard + optional annotation query
chore(grafana): add dashboard validation to CI and standardize templating variables
conversation: Connor O'Brien (review): Can we align naming with the installer upgrade-plan stages? I want SREs to correlate stage names with the plan output. Also, please ensure dashboard variables don’t assume hosted-only labels. Allison Grant (author): Updated stage mapping to match the plan vocabulary (prechecks, backup, control_plane, data_plane, migrations, postchecks). Also switched variable defaults to use cluster/environment labels and made customer optional. Sean Gallagher (review): The precheck fail rate panel looks good, but can we separate blocking vs warning and show top failing checks over the last 24h? Also: please add a "no data" hint for air-gapped installs that don’t have Loki wired. Allison Grant (author): Added a row that splits by severity and a Top 10 failing checks table (by check_id). Added panel description text for Loki fallback and a note in README. Rafael Mendes (review): Migrations dashboard: can we include lock timeout count? We saw lock wait issues in staging and it’s a key signal during upgrades. Also ensure we graph p95 by migration for spotting regressions. Allison Grant (author): Added redwood_db_migration_failures_total{reason="lock_timeout"} and included p50/p95 stat panels by migration. Kira Thompson (review): Please add a short operator note in docs on how to interpret "rollback frequency" and not panic on drills; also mention what counts as a rollback run. Allison Grant (author): Added docs section clarifying rollback run semantics (installer rollback command invocation + result label) and how to filter out drills using the run_reason label when present. Sean Gallagher (final): Approved after the stage naming update and lock-timeout panel. Connor O'Brien (final): Approved; please ensure CHANGELOG entry calls out dashboards only (no functional changes).
release_notes: Added Grafana dashboards for Redwood Private upgrade health: precheck failures, migration durations/timeouts, error rates during upgrade windows, and rollback frequency.
